packaging: paused at user request; no new ZIP has been built
question: At the exact FE99800 panels, does resetting all G/D weights and Adam remove the abnormal generated curves?
randomness: Same explicit twister seed per panel/event for warm and all fresh models; full RNG end states saved for comparison. Only fresh initial weights differ.
freshState: new G/D weights; all Adam moments and counters zero; retain only architecture/condition-frame and gate metadata to keep the frozen task identical
evaluation: Offline, separately billed; no search/population/archive updates. Compare same-axis images, objective distance/coverage, known vs unobserved conditions, and endpoint RMSE as a diagnostic only.
limits: A maximum of 10000 updates is a budget, not proof of convergence; only these six exact late datasets tested.

exploratorySecondary.trigger: Original warm/fresh checkpoints through 5000 still show persistent objective deviations; exact conditional centroids have much smaller gaps.
exploratorySecondary.test: Same G and fresh initialization 600001; full-batch MSE on fixed observed-condition centroids, checkpoints 0/1000/5000/10000, six panels.
exploratorySecondary.purpose: Assess representability, not a controlled loss-only ablation; no new network architecture or online changes.

exploratoryWidthCheck.trigger: Same-G full-batch centroid fitting remains inaccurate even at 10000 updates.
exploratoryWidthCheck.scope: Original LIRCMOP7/8 exact frozen datasets only; change G hidden widths from [32,32] to [128,128], same fixed centroid targets, optimizer and 10000-update budget.
exploratoryWidthCheck.purpose: Check whether fitting improves with capacity; no production or adversarial algorithm change.

criticMismatchIntervention.trigger: All completed models give higher mean scores to mismatched real endpoint/direction pairs; issue also observed for approximately 5-degree condition changes.
criticMismatchIntervention.scope: Original7/8 frozen FE99800, fresh init600001, same 10000 G update budget and native RNG traces as reset1.
criticMismatchIntervention.onlyTrainingChange: D negative batch mixes 50% generated samples and 50% within-side direction-mismatched real endpoints; gradient penalty uses that same mixture. G objective and both architectures unchanged. Permutations deterministic, no extra RNG draws or oracle calls.
criticMismatchIntervention.role: Two-case causal intervention, no tuning or production changes; improvement alone is not evidence of full-search usefulness.
